issue.title: Store raw values in DiscoverySelectors & TestSources

milestone.title: 5.0 M3
milestone.description: Themes: JUnit 4 interoperability, additional discovery selectors.

repository.name: junit-framework
repository.description: ✅ The programmer-friendly testing framework for Java and the JVM

issue.body:
## Overview

In light of issues such as #477 and the discussion in #466,  the JUnit 5 Team has decided to store _raw_ values in all `DiscoverySelector` and `TestSource` implementations for the _entire Platform_.

In other words, the JUnit Platform should not _store_ anything in either selectors or sources using a _biased_ format (e.g., `File` vs. `Path` vs. `URI` vs. `String` _and_ `Method` vs. method name), since it is up to a specific `TestEngine` or IDE to interpret the _raw_ format.
## Proposal for file system sources

Input from @marcphilipp:

> We could change `FileSource` and `DirectorySource` to store a `URI` instead of a `File` and provide methods that return a `File`/`Path` from the `URI`.
## Deliverables
- [x] Ensure that each `DiscoverySelector` implementation stores the selected element in a _raw_ format.
  - Add _getter_ methods for retrieving the raw format as well as technology specific representations.
- [x] Ensure that each `TestSource` implementation stores the source in a _raw_ format.
  - Add _getter_ methods for retrieving the raw format as well as technology specific representations.

body: Tentatively assigned to @bechte in conjunction with his work on #489.

This issue makes the difference of `JavaMethodSelector` and `JavaMethodSource` very obvious. A selector references to the _Thing Under Test_ (also requiring the explicit `Class` to run the tests with), while the source points to the place _where_ the code is defined. Therefore, for the selector we have to extract the class from the fully qualified name and cannot use the `getDeclaringClass()`. For the source, we really want to use `getDeclaringClass()` for its purpose.

I changed this accordingly in both classes (selector and source), see commit 318f097. This will be merged with #489 as it is part of the overall rework on this topic.

## Overview

This pull requests solves the following issues:
- Store raw values in DiscoverySelectors & TestSources #489
- Cannot select default method by fully qualified method name #516
- Non-standard method names are not supported for discovery selection #477
